title: Fulfillment Feasibility Plan
question: Order ORD-028 needs 12 units of PROD-001 and 6 units of PROD-004 for The Sukhothai Hotel by Feb 18. Can we fulfill it? Check stock, identify shortages, find incoming POs, and recommend a carrier — both products need refrigeration.

critical_facts: PROD-004 has 19 available, covering the 6 units needed
PROD-001 has 8 available, 4 short of the 12 needed
PO-008 brings 150 units of PROD-001 on 2026-02-18, same day as deadline — tight
Carrier must be refrigerated: SCG Cold Chain (CAR-002) or Flash Express (CAR-003), NOT Kerry Express (ground)
important_facts: SCG Cold Chain cost is 3,000 THB (120 kg x 25)
Flash Express cost is 4,200 THB (120 kg x 35)
Recommendation favors SCG Cold Chain (same transit, cheaper)
must_not_contain: Claim stock fully covers the order
Fabricated PO that resolves PROD-001 shortage earlier than PO-008
